offering_description.value: Operates an online travel platform with user reviews and booking for hotels, restaurants and experiences. It earns money from advertising and commissions from travel partners, from vacation rental and experience bookings, and from restaurant reservations. It also sells subscriptions to consumers and software to hospitality businesses.

primary_products.value: travel review and booking website and apps; vacation rental marketplace; experiences marketplace; restaurant reservation platform; consumer subscription

primary_services.value: online travel advertising; booking referral and marketplace services; restaurant reservation services; hospitality marketing and software services

customer_segment.value: B2C: travelers and diners who research and book trips, tours and restaurants; B2B: hotels, online travel agencies, tour operators, restaurants and vacation rental owners

end_markets.value: travel; hospitality; restaurants; tourism experiences; vacation rentals

revenue_model.value: advertising: click-based and display advertising from hotels and online travel agencies; commissions or management fees: commissions on experience, rental and hotel bookings made through the platform; subscription: consumer membership plans and business subscriptions for listings and marketing tools; transaction or usage fees: fees on restaurant reservations and software usage
revenue_model.category: advertising; commissions or management fees; subscription; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates a review-based travel marketplace linking travelers to hotels, rentals, tours and restaurants; financial intermediary: earns commissions as an intermediary on bookings between travelers and suppliers

geography_served.value: global: Websites and apps available in many countries and languages worldwide, with listings across most regions

specialization.value: related lines: travel reviews and hotel metasearch, experiences, vacation rentals and restaurant reservations, all serving travelers

distribution_channels.value: online: own websites and mobile apps, plus search engines and social media traffic; direct sales: sales teams selling advertising and subscriptions to hotels and tourism businesses

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy rules such as GDPR, consumer protection and review authenticity rules, and EU digital platform regulation

notes: Brand and segment details are from general knowledge and may be out of date.
